title: 第2章 开学报到
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
清晨六点五十，安槐准时出门。

    他穿着一件简单的白色短袖和黑色长裤，肩上挎着个帆布包，里面塞着录取通知书和一些杂物，保温桶干干净净地拎在手里。

    银灰色发丝在晨光中格外显眼，和黑色头发交织在一起，像是天生自带了滤镜。

    走到苏念念家门口的时候，刚好六点五十八。

    门开着。

    苏念念正站在门口跟一个中年男人说话，那男人身材魁梧，国字脸，眉眼间透着一股不怒自威的气势，穿着一件灰色pOlO衫，双手背在身后，活脱脱一个严父形象。

    苏正川，凝元巅峰。

    “爸，我跟你说过多少次了，到了学校你别一副棺材脸，同学们会怕你的。”苏念念叉着腰教训。

    苏正川面部肌肉微微抽动，低沉的声音里带着一丝委屈：“我正常表情就这样……”

    “那你学着笑一个。”

    苏正川努力扯了扯嘴角。

    苏念念看了一眼，打了个哆嗦：“算了算了，更吓人了，你还是板着吧。”

    安槐看着这一幕，嘴角微微上扬。

    【检测到情绪源“苏正川”释放情绪：无奈（40%）、宠溺（35%）、憋屈（25%）。质量优良，已自动吸收。备注：一个凝元巅峰被亲闺女训得跟孙子似的，这画面我能看一辈子。】

    安槐忍住笑，走上前：“苏叔叔好。”

    苏正川看到安槐，面无表情地点了点头。

    “嗯。”

    就一个字。

    这要是换个不了解他的人，大概会觉得这位苏叔叔对自己有意见，但安槐太清楚了，苏正川这人在外头就这样，话少，脸冷，让人看着就犯怵。

    实际上，安槐小时候发烧，就是这位苏叔叔半夜“拎”着他去的医院，甚至在医院陪了他一整晚，算的上他半个爹。

    “阿姨呢？”安槐问。

    “我妈今天值班，走不开。”苏念念接过保温桶，从安槐手里拎过去搁在门边，扭头上下打量了他一眼，“可以啊，这么白白净净的，不认识的还以为你是哪个世家的公子哥。”

    “老大过奖。”

    “不是夸你，是在说你长得跟你的实力不匹配。”苏念念伸手在他胳膊上捏了一下，“淬体五重，胳膊跟竹竿似的，你这肌肉长哪去了？”

    “在里面。”

    “切。”

    苏正川在旁边听着，嘴角动了动，似乎想说什么，最终还是什么都没说，转身去车库开车。

    几分钟后，一辆黑色的普通家用车停在门口。

    苏念念拉开后门一屁股坐进去，朝安槐招手：“上车，小弟。”

    安槐弯腰钻进车里，在苏念念旁边坐好。

    车子启动，苏正川开车稳得像台自动驾驶仪，不紧不慢地往青岚武道高中的方向开。

    苏念念坐不住，掏出手机翻班级群。

    “哎安槐你看，好多人在群里自我介绍呢。”她把手机屏幕怼到安槐面前。

    安槐扫了一眼。

    群里热闹得很，大部分都是刚录取的新生在打招呼。

    有武道世家的子弟直接报上家门，有普通学生客客气气地说“请多关照”，还有几个在问学校食堂好不好吃。

    安槐注意到一条消息。

    “大家好，我是林落雪，希望以后能和大家做好朋友呢[害羞]”
content_en:
At 6:50 in the morning, An Huai went out on time.

He was wearing a simple white short-sleeved shirt and black trousers, with a canvas bag slung over his shoulder. There was an admission letter and some sundries stuffed inside, and the thermos bucket was neatly carried in his hand.

The silver-gray hair is particularly conspicuous in the morning light, intertwined with the black hair, as if it was born with its own filter.

When we walked to the door of Su Niannian's house, it was exactly six fifty-eight.

The door is open.

Su Niannian was standing at the door talking to a middle-aged man. The man was burly, with a Chinese character face, and an air of self-reliance between his eyebrows. He was wearing a gray pOlO shirt, with his hands behind his back, and he looked like a strict father.

Su Zhengchuan, the peak of Ning Yuan.

"Dad, how many times have I told you, don't look like a coffin face when you get to school, your classmates will be afraid of you." Su Niannian taught him a lesson with her hands on her hips.

Su Zhengchuan's facial muscles twitched slightly, and there was a hint of grievance in his deep voice: "My normal expression is like this..."

"Then you learn to smile."

Su Zhengchuan tried his best to twitch his lips.

Su Niannian glanced at it and shuddered: "Forget it, forget it, it's even scarier, you better keep calm."

An Huai looked at this scene and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.

[The emotion source "Su Zhengchuan" was detected to release emotions: helplessness (40%), pampering (35%), and frustration (25%).Excellent quality, has been absorbed automatically.Note: I can watch this scene of a peak Ning Yuan being trained like a grandson by his own daughter.】

An Huai held back his laughter and stepped forward: "Hello, Uncle Su."

When Su Zhengchuan saw An Huai, he nodded expressionlessly.

"Yeah."

Just one word.

If someone didn't know him well, he would probably think that Uncle Su had a problem with him, but An Huai knew very well that Su Zhengchuan was like this outside. He talked little and had a cold face, which made people feel scared just looking at him.

In fact, when An Huai had a fever when he was a child, it was Uncle Su who "carried" him to the hospital in the middle of the night. He even stayed with him in the hospital all night, making him half his father.

"Where's Auntie?" An Huai asked.

"My mother is on duty today and can't leave." Su Niannian took the thermos bucket, took it from An Huai's hand and placed it by the door. She turned her head and looked him up and down, "Okay, you're so fair and fair. People who don't know you would think you are a young master from a certain family."

"Thank you, boss."

"I'm not praising you, I'm saying that your looks don't match your strength." Su Niannian stretched out her hand and pinched his arm, "Fifth level of body tempering, your arms are like bamboo poles, where did your muscles grow?"

"Inside."

"Tch."

Su Zhengchuan listened beside him, his mouth moved as if he wanted to say something, but in the end he said nothing and turned around to go to the garage to drive.

A few minutes later, a black ordinary family car parked at the door.

Su Niannian opened the back door and sat in, waving to An Huai: "Get in the car, little brother."

An Huai bent down and got into the car, sitting next to Su Niannian.

The car started, and Su Zhengchuan drove as steadily as an autopilot, driving unhurriedly in the direction of Qinglan Martial Arts High School.

Su Niannian couldn't sit still, so she took out her mobile phone and scrolled through the class group.

"Hey An Huai, look, a lot of people are introducing themselves in the group." She pointed the phone screen in front of An Huai.

An Huai glanced at it.

The group was very lively, and most of them were freshmen who had just been admitted and were saying hello.

Some children from martial arts families came directly to their homes, some ordinary students politely said "please take care of me", and a few asked if the school cafeteria was delicious.

An Huai noticed a message.

"Hello everyone, I am Lin Luoxue. I hope I can be good friends with you all in the future [shy]"
title_en: Chapter 2 Registration for the start of school
